free_tier.stated: Free personal plan: 10 GB storage, 5 members per project, 1 GB per single file (secondary source says 2 GB free). Paid: 100 GB / 300 GB / 1 TB / 2 TB / 3 TB / 5 TB+. Storage counts '归属于团队的项目、资源库中的文件及回收站内未永久删除的文件'.

egress.terms: Not metered separately; the product is a review/approval tool, not a CDN. No public bandwidth line found.

tooling: OpenList driver `mediatrack` (access_token + project_id, order_by/order_desc) — a working mount over the video-collaboration API.
chaining: 10 GB per account, team-based, so projects multiply but storage is billed per team. 1 GB/file.
limits_note: per-object-cap: 1 GB. quota: 10 GB free. Commercial pivot in 2022 ('将于2022年7月25日起正式收费') means the free tier is a residual, not a strategy.
reliability_note: Paying product with a stable API; free tier is deliberately vestigial.
confidence_note: One page read moves it to documented.
